pick.name: Resend
pick.what: Developer email API with React Email
pick.why: Best DX/typed SDK for Claude Code; ToS free tier has no non-commercial clause

alts.name: Brevo Free
alts.why: Best free volume (~300/day) if Resend's 100/day bites
alts.free_limits: 300 emails/day per third-party reviews (Brevo page fetch was empty); Brevo branding on free

alts.name: Amazon SES
alts.free_limits: No permanent free tier; new AWS accounts get up to $200 credits for 12 months; dedicated IP $24.95/mo

candidates.name: Brevo
candidates.verdict: Alt: more free volume, less dev-centric

candidates.name: Amazon SES
candidates.verdict: Alt: cheapest at scale, more setup

candidates.name: Postmark
candidates.verdict: Best deliverability reputation; free only 100/mo, Basic $15 for 10k

candidates.name: Mailgun
candidates.verdict: Free 100/day sandbox-ish; PAYG reportedly doubled Dec 2025 (third-party)

candidates.name: SendGrid
candidates.verdict: Rejected: permanent free plan retired May 2025 (60-day trial now)

candidates.name: Cloudflare Email Service (Workers send_email)
candidates.verdict: Beta, requires Workers Paid; watch it - could replace Resend inside Workers

decision: Resend has the cleanest API and 3 free domains, enough for several products' auth/receipts emails. Move to Pro ($20) or SES when you exceed 100/day; SES is cheapest above ~50k/mo.

verify.note: Resend: 3,000/mo, 100/day, 3 domains, 30-day retention; Pro $20 for 50k. ToS: the free tier has no non-commercial clause. SES: no permanent free tier; up to $200 credits for new accounts (free plan 6 months, credits within 12 months); dedicated IP $24.95. SendGrid's permanent free plan was retired in 2025 (Twilio changelog 2025-05-27; 60-day trial for new accounts from 2025-03-25), so excluding it was correct.
